steps.text: Click "Create a community" above the list to open the creation dialog.
steps.title: Create a community

steps.text: Enter the community name. The regulator is preselected (CWaPE for Wallonia); change it if your community reports to a different regional regulator.
steps.title: Name the community

steps.text: Click "Confirm". The community is created in the CRM and the identity provider, and you automatically become its administrator.
steps.title: Confirm the creation

steps.text: Search for the new community in the list.
steps.title: Find the community

steps.text: "E2E Community" now appears in your list. All that's left is to activate it and start setting it up.
steps.title: Your new community

steps.text: Activate the new community: its management menus appear in the sidebar.
steps.title: Activate the community

steps.text: Activate the new community: its management menus appear in the sidebar.
steps.title: Activate the community

steps.text: The "Management" section appears in the sidebar: as its creator, you are the community administrator and have access to all its tools.
steps.title: You are the administrator
